tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page. Body text on it is `foreground`; secondary text is `muted-foreground`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and the lightest surface (same tone as `surface-container-lowest`). Text on it: `card-foreground`.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lightest step of the surface ladder; equal to `card` in light, `canvas` in dark.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, hovered rows, quiet panels on the page. Replaces `bg-muted/35` to `/60`.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Default filled container: tab strips, neutral chips, recessed tiles. Equal to `muted` in light.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: A container that must stand out from `surface-container` beside it.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Strongest neutral fill. Equal to `canvas` in light and `muted` in dark.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Neutral ground behind a rendered resume page in the studio previews.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Recessed neutral fill. Prefer the `surface-container-*` step that says how recessed.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, placeholders-as-prompts and inactive icons on any surface (4.5:1 pinned).

tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip or a small button (`gap-1`).

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a default button; dot to label in a status chip (`gap-1.5`).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The default gap between sibling controls (`gap-2`).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a title and its supporting block; header wrap gap (`gap-3`).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between cards (`p-4`, `gap-4`).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding and the gap between page sections (`p-6`, `gap-6`).
